cover_headline: Sold-Out Eden Park Crowd to Break New Zealand Bilateral Record for India T20I
facts: Friday's fourth T20I between New Zealand and India at Eden Park is sold out, with nearly 40,000 fans expected in Auckland
The crowd will break New Zealand's bilateral series attendance record of 36,523, set at an Eden Park double-header against India in 2019
More than 126,000 tickets have been sold across India's full tour, including over 71,000 for the five-match T20I series alone; India already lead the series 3-0

end.headline: Sold-Out Eden Park Crowd to Break New Zealand Bilateral Record for India T20I
end.line: Nearly 40,000 fans will watch Friday's fourth T20I in Auckland, passing the 36,523 mark set in 2019 — for a series India have already won.
